documents.text: 这四条线段所在的直线不同。却都包含原点。蓝色与橙色两条穿过原点。紫色这一条在这里结束。绿色这一条从这里开始。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">这四条线段所在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同。<break time="200ms"/>却<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>包含原点。<break time="400ms"/>蓝<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="se 4 yu 3">色与</phoneme>橙<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="se 4">色</phoneme>两条穿过原点。<break time="200ms"/>紫<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="se 4">色</phoneme>这<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条在这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lv 4 se 4">绿色</phoneme>这<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>这里开始。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 沿用同点报告规则。开始者已经加入。结束者在报告后才退出。所以报告时。这四条闭线段分别属于四个不同的非零同线组。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2">沿</phoneme>用同点报告规则。<break time="200ms"/>开始者已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>加入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束者在报告后才退出。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>报告时。<break time="200ms"/>这四条闭线段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2 shu 3">分别属</phoneme>于四个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>非零同线组。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 依次记录这六个不同的原始无序输入对。结果都位于原点。但每对身份分别保留。这里只处理一个事件位置。却已经要输出六条结果。事件少。不代表这一次要做的工作少。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">依次记录这六个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始无序输入对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>位于原点。<break time="200ms"/>但每对身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 fen 1 bie 2">份分别</phoneme>保留。<break time="400ms"/>这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 chu 2 li 3 yi 2">只处理一</phoneme>个事件位置。<break time="200ms"/>却已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1 yao 4">经要</phoneme>输出六条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果。<break time="200ms"/>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3">少</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>代表这<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>做<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 shao 3">作少</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用字母 n 表示原始输入份数。用字母 k 表示相交的原始无序输入对数。每对的完整交集算一条。点和非零闭区间都如此。重合输入仍各算一份。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用字母 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">N</say-as></lang> 表示原始输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>用字母 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">K</say-as></lang> 表示<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始无序输入对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>每对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整交集算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条。<break time="200ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>非零闭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1 dou 1">区间都</phoneme>如此。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 he 2">重合</phoneme>输入仍各算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用大写 E 累计处理了多少不同事件位置。用大写 H 把每次参与的不同非零同线组数加起来。同一个组在不同事件参加。要分别计入。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4 xie 3">大写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">E</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 chu 2 li 3 le 5">累计处理了</phoneme>多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 bu 4">少不</phoneme>同事件位置。<break time="400ms"/>用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4 xie 3">大写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">H</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>每次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 de 5 bu 4">参与的不</phoneme>同非零同线组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 3 lai 5">起来</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个组在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1">参</phoneme>加。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 fen 1 bie 2">要分别</phoneme>计入。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 沿完整位置次序走过七个事件。每次参与的组数依次是一、一、一、四、一、一、一。于是全程事件数是七。累计参与组数是十。相交原始对数是六。原点那一次的局部数目仍然是一、四、六。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2">沿</phoneme>完整位置次序走过七个事件。<break time="200ms"/>每次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 de 5">参与的</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>依次是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、四、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>于是全程事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>是七。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4">累计参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>是十。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交原始对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>是六。<break time="200ms"/>原点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 4 yi 2">那一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>局部<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>目仍然是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、四、六。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 本集数的是精确算术、比较和基本记录操作的次数。例如一次有理数运算、一次坐标比较或一次记录访问。一次树查找包含多次比较。不能把整次查找免费算作一个基本操作。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">本集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 3 de 5">数的</phoneme>是精确算术、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>基本记录操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 de 5">作的</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>例如<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2 li 3 shu 4">有理数</phoneme>运算、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较或<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次记录访问。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次树<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>找包含多次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>整次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>找免费算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 yi 2">作一</phoneme>个基本操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 活动组顺序使用 A V L 树。队列、固定组查找和成员索引也使用有序容器。这里沿用这些容器的对数操作成本。不展开平衡维护。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">活动组顺序使用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">V</say-as></lang> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">L</say-as></lang> 树。<break time="200ms"/>队列、固定组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>找<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yin 3">索引</phoneme>也使用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>序容器。<break time="400ms"/>这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2">沿</phoneme>用这些容器<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>成本。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>展开平衡维护。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 先讨论至少有一份输入的情况。对数的底取二。大写 O 表示操作次数可以由所写表达式的固定常数倍控制。它不是每份输入的精确次数。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">先讨<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lun 4">论</phoneme>至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 you 3 yi 2 fen 4">少有一份</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>情况。<break time="200ms"/>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5 di 3 qu 3">数的底取</phoneme>二。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4 xie 3">大写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">O</say-as></lang> 表示操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 ke 2 yi 3">数可以</phoneme>由所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xie 3">写</phoneme>表达式<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>固定常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>倍控制。<break time="200ms"/>它<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>是每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>精确次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每份非零输入至多提供两个端点位置。点输入只提供一个。共享位置合并只会减少数量。所以端点位置至多是原始输入份数的两倍。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>非零输入至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ti 2">提</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 1">供</phoneme>两个端点位置。<break time="200ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ti 2">提</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 1 yi 2">供一</phoneme>个。<break time="400ms"/>共享位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>并<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>减<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 shu 4 liang 4">少数量</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>端点位置至多是原始输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4 de 5">份数的</phoneme>两倍。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 其余事件位置来自不同支撑直线上的真实交点。给每个这样的位置选一对在这里相交的原始输入作为见证。不同直线至多有一个交点。所以同一对不能给两个不同位置作见证。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">其余事件位置来自<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同支撑直线上<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实交点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>每个这样<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>位置选<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>对在这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 wei 2">作为</phoneme>见证。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同直线至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 yi 2">有一</phoneme>个交点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>见证。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 因此。非端点事件位置至多有 k 个。加上端点来源。事件数至多是输入份数的两倍。再加相交原始对数。重叠区间内的无穷多个点。不会各自成为事件。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">因此。<break time="200ms"/>非端点事件位置至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">K</say-as></lang> 个。<break time="200ms"/>加上端点来源。<break time="200ms"/>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>至多是输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4 de 5">份数的</phoneme>两倍。<break time="200ms"/>再加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交原始对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 die 2 qu 1 jian 1">重叠区间</phoneme>内<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>无穷多个点。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>各自成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>事件。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 任一事件位置用小写 p 表示。用 h 下标 p 表示这里不同的非零参与组数。处理前经过当前位置的旧活动组与本次开始者所属的组合并。同组只算一次。点输入不算组。结束者报告后才退出。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4 yi 1">任一</phoneme>事件位置用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiao 2 xie 3">小写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表示。<break time="200ms"/>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">H</say-as></lang> 下标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表示这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme>前<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>过<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1">当</phoneme>前位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>旧活动组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>本次开始者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 shu 3 de 5">所属的</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>并。<break time="200ms"/>同组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次。<break time="400ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>算组。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束者报告后才退出。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用 c 下标 p 表示这里新报告的跨组非零输入对数。同线对和含点输入的对不计在这个量中。回到原点的报告时刻。参与组数是四。这次跨组新输出是六。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> 下标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表示这里新报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>跨组非零输入对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>同线对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>含点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>计在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 liang 4 zhong 1">这个量中</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>回到原点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>报告时刻。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>是四。<break time="200ms"/>这次跨组新输出是六。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 至少有两个组时。每组都非空。而且各成员包含当前位置。每两个组各选一份成员。就得到一个真实相交的原始输入对。不同组对选出的原始对不同。因此组对的数量。不超过这一次的跨组新输出数量。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 you 3">少有</phoneme>两个组时。<break time="200ms"/>每组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>非<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>而且各成员包含<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1">当</phoneme>前位置。<break time="400ms"/>每两个组各选<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>成员。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2">得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始输入对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同组对选出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>原始对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>同。<break time="200ms"/>因此组对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 shu 4 liang 4">的数量</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>超过这<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>跨组新输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 liang 4">数量</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 参与组数至少为二时。将它减一。所得的数至少为一。因此参与组数不超过参与组数与这个差的乘积。再用上一行的界。就得到参与组数不超过当场跨组新输出数的两倍。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 wei 2">少为</phoneme>二时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiang 1">将</phoneme>它减<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2 de 5 shu 4">得的数</phoneme>至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 wei 2 yi 1">少为一</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>因此<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 yu 3 zhe 4 ge 5 cha 1 de 5 cheng 2">数与这个差的乘</phoneme>积。<break time="200ms"/>再用上<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4 hang 2 de 5">一行的</phoneme>界。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2">得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 chang 3">当场</phoneme>跨组新输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>两倍。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 只有一个组时。这一个组的贡献计在事件本身。零个组时没有组贡献。例如孤立的点输入事件。点输入需要的输出工作稍后单独计入。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2">只有一</phoneme>个组时。<break time="200ms"/>这<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>贡献计在事件本身。<break time="400ms"/>零个组时<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>组贡献。<break time="200ms"/>例如孤立<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点输入事件。<break time="200ms"/>点输入需<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 de 5">要的</phoneme>输出工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 1">稍</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1">单</phoneme>独计入。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 把每次事件的参与组数相加。用大写 H 表示这个和。画面上的求和符号。就是把每个位置对应的量加起来。每个事件保守记一次。再加两倍的跨组新输出总数。就覆盖了零组、单组和多组情况。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>每次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 can 1 yu 4">的参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 xiang 1">数相</phoneme>加。<break time="200ms"/>用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4 xie 3">大写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">H</say-as></lang> 表示<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5 he 2">这个和</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>画面上<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>求<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>符<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>每个位置对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ying 4 de 5 liang 4">应的量</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 3 lai 5">起来</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>每个事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bao 2 shou 3">保守</phoneme>记<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次。<break time="200ms"/>再加两倍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>跨组新输出总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就覆盖<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="le 5">了</phoneme>零组、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1">单</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>多组情况。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 上集的跨组唯一报告保证。同一个原始对不会在别的事件再次支付费用。所以全部跨组新输出数不超过 k 这个总数。代入事件数的界。累计参与组数至多是输入份数的两倍。再加相交原始对数的三倍。于是它是输入量与输出量之和的常数倍。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">上集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>跨组唯<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>报告保证。<break time="200ms"/>同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个原始对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bie 2 de 5">别的</phoneme>事件再次支付费用。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>全部跨组新输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">K</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>代入事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>界。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4">累计参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>至多是输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4 de 5">份数的</phoneme>两倍。<break time="200ms"/>再加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>交原始对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>三倍。<break time="200ms"/>于是它是输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 yu 3">量与</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>之<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 de 5">和的</phoneme>常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>倍。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 换成一个独立的三输入案例。两份长成员都覆盖从零到六的闭区间。一份短成员覆盖从二到三的闭区间。三份都在横轴上。分行只为区分身份。并没有改变几何高度。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">换成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个独立<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>三输入案例。<break time="200ms"/>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 chang 2 cheng 2 yuan 2 dou 1">份长成员都</phoneme>覆盖<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>零到六<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>闭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>短成员覆盖<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>二到三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>闭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 dou 1">份都</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zhou 2">横轴</phoneme>上。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 hang 2 zhi 3 wei 4 qu 1 fen 1">分行只为区分</phoneme>身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>并<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>改变<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3">几</phoneme>何高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 当 x 坐标为零时。两个长成员报告一条从零到六的完整重叠区间。当 x 坐标为二时。短成员与两个长成员分别报告一条从二到三的完整重叠区间。前两次事件分别新增一对和两对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1">当</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>零时。<break time="200ms"/>两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 cheng 2 yuan 2">长成员</phoneme>报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>零到六<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 die 2 qu 1 jian 1">重叠区间</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1">当</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>二时。<break time="200ms"/>短成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 cheng 2 yuan 2 fen 1 bie 2">长成员分别</phoneme>报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>二到三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 die 2 qu 1 jian 1">重叠区间</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>前两次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2">分别</phoneme>新增<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>两对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 到 x 坐标为三时。只按结束身份删除短成员。两个长成员和这个组继续保留。这里不遍历整个旧成员表。也不重新输出。先前的长区间结果始终保持完整。不能拿它支付每一次全组扫描。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>三时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>删除短成员。<break time="200ms"/>两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 cheng 2 yuan 2 he 2 zhe 4 ge 5">长成员和这个</phoneme>组继续保留。<break time="400ms"/>这里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>遍历整个旧成员表。<break time="200ms"/>也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 chong 2 xin 1">不重新</phoneme>输出。<break time="200ms"/>先前<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 chang 2 qu 1 jian 1 jie 2">的长区间结</phoneme>果始终保持完整。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能拿它支付每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次全组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="sao 3">扫</phoneme>描。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 到 x 坐标为六时。两个长成员结束。组才变空。四次事件的新输出依次是一、二、零、零。累计仍是三对。结束事件所做的必要删除另计。但不重新枚举这些旧对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>六时。<break time="200ms"/>两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 cheng 2 yuan 2 jie 2">长成员结</phoneme>束。<break time="200ms"/>组才变<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>四次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>新输出依次是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、二、零、零。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4">累计</phoneme>仍是三对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>束事件所做<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>删除另计。<break time="200ms"/>但<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 chong 2 xin 1">不重新</phoneme>枚举这些旧对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用大写 M 下标 p 表示非零参与成员总数。用 t 下标 p 表示这个位置的点输入数。普通计算只在至少有两个组。或者有点输入时。才把相关成员展开成临时列表。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4 xie 3">大写</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">M</say-as></lang> 下标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表示非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>成员总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">T</say-as></lang> 下标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表示<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>普<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 1">通</phoneme>计算<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>在至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 you 3">少有</phoneme>两个组。<break time="200ms"/>或者<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>点输入时。<break time="200ms"/>才<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3 xiang 1">把相</phoneme>关成员展开成临时列表。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 至少有两个组时。每份成员至少与另一个组的一份成员配对。将各成员参与跨组输出的次数相加。每条结果被两端各数一次。因此展开的成员总数。不超过跨组新输出数的两倍。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 you 3">少有</phoneme>两个组时。<break time="200ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>成员至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3 yu 3">少与</phoneme>另<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 2 fen 4">的一份</phoneme>成员配对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiang 1">将</phoneme>各成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>跨组输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 xiang 1">数相</phoneme>加。<break time="200ms"/>每条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果被两端各<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 3 yi 2">数一</phoneme>次。<break time="200ms"/>因此展开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>成员总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>超过跨组新输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>两倍。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 只有一个组但有点输入时。每份成员至少产生一个新的点与线段的结果。足够支付展开。只有一个组而没有点输入时。不展开整个旧成员表。零个组时。没有非零成员可展开。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2">只有一</phoneme>个组但<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>点输入时。<break time="200ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>成员至<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3">少</phoneme>产生<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>线段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 jie 2">的结</phoneme>果。<break time="200ms"/>足够支付展开。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2">只有一</phoneme>个组而<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>点输入时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>展开整个旧成员表。<break time="200ms"/>零个组时。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>非零成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>展开。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 新同线成员逐个加入。每次访问旧成员。都立即产生一条新结果。每次加入至多做一次空表检查。游标推进也保守按对数成本计费。最后一次失败推进紧随最后一个结果。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">新同线成员逐个加入。<break time="200ms"/>每次访问旧成员。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>立即产生<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>条新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果。<break time="400ms"/>每次加入至多做<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>表检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>游标推进也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bao 2 shou 3">保守</phoneme>按对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>成本计费。<break time="200ms"/>最后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次失败推进紧随最后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 跨组与点和线段配对时。外层成员访问也由这次新结果支付。点与点按原始无序对输出。没有非零组时。每个点仍有一次外层开销。所有位置的点身份合计至多有 n 份。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">跨组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>线段配对时。<break time="200ms"/>外层成员访问也由这次新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果支付。<break time="200ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>点按原始无序对输出。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2 you 3">没有</phoneme>非零组时。<break time="200ms"/>每个点仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3 yi 2">有一</phoneme>次外层开销。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 you 3">所有</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>计至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">N</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每条结果只保存两个身份。以及一个点或两个区间端点。构造与坐标还原需要固定次数的精确操作。全部结果追加按容器的摊还保证累计为输出数的常数倍。扩容移动已经包括在内。临时成员表的创建和销毁。也按已经支付的展开量计入。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>保存两个身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>以及<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个点或两个<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 1 jian 1">区间</phoneme>端点。<break time="400ms"/>构造<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="huan 2 yuan 2">还原</phoneme>需<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>固定次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>精确操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>全部<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果追加按容器<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 tan 1 huan 2">的摊还</phoneme>保证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 wei 2">累计为</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>倍。<break time="200ms"/>扩容移动已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>包括在内。<break time="200ms"/>临时成员表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 chuang 4">的创</phoneme>建<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>销毁。<break time="200ms"/>也按已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>支付<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>展开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>计入。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 输入准备、必要剪切、固定组与端点缓存按输入量累计。每份非零成员只加入和退出各一次。两套成员索引同步增删。最远右端从最大键读取。不重扫全组。这些有序维护合计为输入份数乘以对数的数量级。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">输入准备、必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>剪<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qie 1">切</phoneme>、固定组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>端点缓存按输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 lei 3 ji 4">量累计</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>非零成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>加入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>退出各<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次。<break time="200ms"/>两套成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yin 3">索引</phoneme>同步增删。<break time="200ms"/>最远右端<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cong 2">从</phoneme>最<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4">大</phoneme>键<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 2 qu 3">读取</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 chong 2 sao 3">不重扫</phoneme>全组。<break time="200ms"/>这些<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>序维护<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>计<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2">为</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4 cheng 2">份数乘</phoneme>以对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5 shu 4 liang 4">数的数量</phoneme>级。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每次只定位相遇块。访问参与组和常数个边界。开始身份在全程至多有 n 份。块的移除、过滤和重插按累计参与量计费。不扫描其余活动组。于是总账由事件数、累计参与组数和输入份数共同控制。再乘有序操作的对数成本。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>定位<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>遇块。<break time="200ms"/>访问<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>个边界。<break time="400ms"/>开始身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>在全程至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">N</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>块<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>移除、过滤<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 chong 2 cha 1">和重插</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4 liang 4">累计参与量</phoneme>计费。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 sao 3">不扫</phoneme>描其余活动组。<break time="200ms"/>于是总账由事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4">累计参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 he 2">数和</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>共同控制。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cheng 2 you 3">乘有</phoneme>序操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 de 5">作的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>成本。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 局部排序只移动组身份。不移动整组成员。固定的精确斜率给出一致次序。采用具有最坏情况下对数乘线性保证的比较排序。每次参与组数不超过输入份数。所以逐次排序成本相加。不超过累计参与组数乘以对数。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">局部排序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>移动组身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>移动整组成员。<break time="200ms"/>固定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>精确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xie 2 lv 4 gei 3">斜率给</phoneme>出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 zhi 4">一致</phoneme>次序。<break time="400ms"/>采用具<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme>最坏情况下对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 cheng 2">数乘</phoneme>线性保证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 bi 3">的比</phoneme>较排序。<break time="200ms"/>每次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>逐次排序成本<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>加。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>超过<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4">累计参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 cheng 2">数乘</phoneme>以对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 更新后的新块非空且有 r 个组时。新块只保留参与本次事件的组。因此组数不超过本次参与组数。内部邻居对数至多是组数减一。两端各至多一对。空块只可能接起原来的两侧。覆盖延长后。即使邻居名字没变。对相关邻接的补检也包含在这里。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 1 xin 1">更新</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>新块非<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>且<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 3">有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">R</say-as></lang> 个组时。<break time="200ms"/>新块<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 bao 3">只保</phoneme>留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>本次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>组。<break time="200ms"/>因此组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过本次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>内部邻居对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>至多是组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>减<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>两端各至多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>块<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 ke 3">只可</phoneme>能接起原来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>两侧。<break time="200ms"/>覆盖延<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2">长</phoneme>后。<break time="200ms"/>即使邻居<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 zi 5 mei 2">名字没</phoneme>变。<break time="200ms"/>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1">相</phoneme>关邻接<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>补检也包含在这里。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 每次事件的检查量由参与组数加一控制。累计就是参与组总数与事件数之和的数量级。每次用固定直线和真实覆盖检查候选。不展开两组全部成员对。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">每次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 liang 4">查量</phoneme>由<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>控制。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4">累计</phoneme>就是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 yu 3">数与</phoneme>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>之<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 de 5 shu 4 liang 4">和的数量</phoneme>级。<break time="400ms"/>每次用固定直线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>真实覆盖检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>候选。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>展开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 2 zu 3">两组</phoneme>全部成员对。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 同一个真实未来位置可能被再次发现。队列只保留一份。但这次查找和尝试仍然收费。尝试总数不超过检查总数。不能只数最后成功新增的位置。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个真实未来位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>能被再次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1">发</phoneme>现。<break time="200ms"/>队列<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>保留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>但这次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>找<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>尝试仍然收费。<break time="200ms"/>尝试总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 bu 4">数不</phoneme>超过检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme>总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3 shu 3">只数</phoneme>最后成功新增<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>位置。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 由事件数界和第一章的输入对数上界。事件数加一不超过输入份数加一所得的和的平方。因此。队列的一次对数操作成本。也受输入份数加一的对数的常数倍控制。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">由事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>界<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>第<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>输入对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>上界。<break time="200ms"/>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 bu 4">一不</phoneme>超过输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>所<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2 de 5 he 2 de 5">得的和的</phoneme>平方。<break time="400ms"/>因此。<break time="200ms"/>队列<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 2">的一</phoneme>次对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>成本。<break time="200ms"/>也受输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 de 5">一的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 de 5">数的</phoneme>常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>倍控制。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 初始化至多登记输入份数两倍的端点身份。之后计入全部预约尝试和每个事件的一次弹出。检查中的覆盖读取也收费。合计仍由输入量与输出量之和。乘以输入份数加一的对数来控制。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">初始化至多登记输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>两倍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>端点身<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4">份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>之后计入全部预<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yue 1">约</phoneme>尝试<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>每个事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 yi 2">的一</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tan 2 chu 1">弹出</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 zhong 1 de 5">查中的</phoneme>覆盖<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 2 qu 3">读取</phoneme>也收费。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme>计仍由输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 yu 3">量与</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>之<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cheng 2">乘</phoneme>以输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 de 5">一的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>来控制。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 局部组表累计按参与组总数与事件数计费。必要成员表已经由新输出支付。高度缓存按实际访问更新。不每次重算全部组。最后释放几何、组和映射的工作按输入量计。逐条释放结果按输出量计。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">局部组表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4">累计</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme>组总<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 yu 3">数与</phoneme>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>计费。<break time="200ms"/>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>成员表已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>由新输出支付。<break time="400ms"/>高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>缓存按实际访问<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 1 xin 1">更新</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>每次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 suan 4">重算</phoneme>全部组。<break time="200ms"/>最后释放<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ji 3">几</phoneme>何、组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>映射<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>按输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>计。<break time="200ms"/>逐条释放<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果按输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>计。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 账本里的每一行都受同一个上界控制。固定行数相加只改变常数。因此。普通求交的精确算术、比较和基本状态操作次数。由输入量与输出量之和。乘以输入份数加一的对数来控制。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">账本里<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4 hang 2 dou 1">一行都</phoneme>受同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>个上界控制。<break time="200ms"/>固定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hang 2 shu 4 xiang 1">行数相</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>改变常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>因此。<break time="200ms"/>普<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 1">通</phoneme>求交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>精确算术、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>基本状态操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>由输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 yu 3">量与</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>之<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cheng 2">乘</phoneme>以输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 de 5">一的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>来控制。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 只有一份输入时。输入份数加一的对数等于一。仍能容纳固定工作。空输入的调用和空状态处理另外计常数开销。若合写所有规模。就在主界的表达式前加一。这个加一是记法选择。不是性能改进。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3 yi 2 fen 4">只有一份</phoneme>输入时。<break time="200ms"/>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 4 shu 4">份数</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1 de 5">一的</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>等于<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>仍能容纳固定工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 diao 4 yong 4 he 2 kong 1">的调用和空</phoneme>状态<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme>另外计常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>开销。<break time="200ms"/>若<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xie 3 suo 2 you 3">写所有</phoneme>规<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mo 2">模</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就在主界<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>表达式前加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>是记法选择。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>是性能改进。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 回到原点这个事件。定位、局部排序、邻接检查和六条结果。属于普通求交。必要的成员展开和临时表也已经计入。不能把这些必要工作推到教学成本一栏。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">回到原点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>事件。<break time="200ms"/>定位、局部排序、邻接检<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 he 2">查和</phoneme>六条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">结</phoneme>果。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 3">属</phoneme>于普<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 1">通</phoneme>求交。<break time="400ms"/>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4 de 5">要的</phoneme>成员展开<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>临时表也已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>计入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>这些必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>推到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiao 4">教</phoneme>学成本<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4">一</phoneme>栏。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 同一次精确比较或算术。成本还取决于数字长度。有理数的分子、分母越长。乘除、比较或约分可能越费时。前面的操作次数界。不能直接当作秒数、固定字节成本或完整的位复杂度定理。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">同<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2">一</phoneme>次精确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较或算术。<break time="200ms"/>成本<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2 qu 3">还取</phoneme>决于<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>字<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 du 4">长度</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="you 2 li 3 shu 4 de 5 fen 1 zi 3">有理数的分子</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 mu 3 yue 4 chang 2">分母越长</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cheng 2">乘</phoneme>除、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3">比</phoneme>较或<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yue 1">约</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 ke 3">分可</phoneme>能越费时。<break time="400ms"/>前面<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>操<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4">作</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>界。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能直接<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 4 zuo 4">当作</phoneme>秒<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>、固定字节成本或完整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>位复杂<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>定理。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 教学模式可能在多个停步重复保存全活动状态、成员说明和累计结果。还要格式化、传输和展示。这些额外访问未必受输入量与输出量之和控制。教学来自真实执行。并不意味着记录免费。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiao 4">教</phoneme>学<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mo 2">模</phoneme>式<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme>能在多个停步<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 fu 4">重复</phoneme>保存全活动状态、成员<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1">说</phoneme>明<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2 lei 3 ji 4 jie 2">和累计结</phoneme>果。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2 yao 4">还要</phoneme>格式化、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chuan 2">传</phoneme>输<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>展示。<break time="400ms"/>这些额外访问未必受输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 yu 3">量与</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>之<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>控制。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiao 4">教</phoneme>学来自真实执<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xing 2">行</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>并<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 yi 4 wei 4 zhe 5">不意味着</phoneme>记录免费。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 事件数控制到站次数。累计参与组数控制局部维护。成员展开由当场的新输出支付。再把重复预约和必要清理计入。就把普通求交的总工作量连接到了输入量与输出量。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>控制到站次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lei 3 ji 4 can 1 yu 4">累计参与</phoneme>组<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4">数</phoneme>控制局部维护。<break time="400ms"/>成员展开由<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 chang 3 de 5">当场的</phoneme>新输出支付。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3 chong 2 fu 4">把重复</phoneme>预<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yue 1">约</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>清理计入。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>普<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 1">通</phoneme>求交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>总工<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zuo 4 liang 4">作量</phoneme>连接到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="le 5">了</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4 yu 3">量与</phoneme>输出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="liang 4">量</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 一次事件可以很大。一个组也可以很大。累计账本仍然有依据。这里得到的是普通操作次数界。数值长度和教学记录保留各自的成本边界。
